title: The Onam Festival Celebration 2025 Brought the Entire Sri Shanmugha Family Together in a Vibrant Display of Culture, Tradition, and Unity
content: The entire Sri Shanmugha family came together for a grand Onam celebration in 2025, filling the campus with festive colors and cultural richness. The event featured Pookalam competitions, Thiruvathira dance performances, and traditional Onam Sadhya.
